data.title: Field Marketing Manager
data.description:
Field Marketing Manager, US

Location: Remote (US), Eastern time zone preferred
Travel: ~30% for conferences, dinners, and regional events

About Haast

We're building one of the first agentic systems for enterprise legal and compliance teams that actually automates their manual work. End-to-end. Delivering 80% faster compliance reviews and 4x productivity gains.

We recently closed a $12M USD Series A (Peak XV Partners, DST Global, Airtree) and are ramping hard; building the infrastructure that will completely re-define how enterprises think about compliance.

Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.

Why This Role Exists

As Haast enters the US market after building traction in Australia, we know buyers don't find us by accident. They see us at the right conference. They get pulled into the right campaign. They hear from a rep with the right message at the right moment. All of that has to come together for a fast moving financial services buyer to actually pick Haast.

This role owns that work end to end: events, campaigns, ABM, digital activation, email, and the enablement that gets sales the tools and timing they need.

What You'll Own

  • Run the US field marketing calendar end to end: conference sponsorships, executive dinners, roundtables, and webinars – from concept through budget, logistics, promotion, and follow-up

  • Build and execute account-based programs against Haast's priority accounts, working closely with sales to identify targets and tailor engagement

  • Run integrated, pain-based campaigns that pair field activity with outbound, content, and paid support

  • Manage HubSpot as our marketing system of record – campaign builds, workflows, list management, and reporting – keeping data clean and attribution accurate

  • Run email marketing that supports campaigns and nurtures accounts through the pipeline

  • Develop co-marketing relationships with partners as they're established, from joint events to shared campaigns

  • Support website work: content updates, landing pages, and ongoing optimization

  • Manage US paid media activation in support of campaigns and events

  • Build sales enablement materials and give the US sales team what they need, when they need it, to work field and campaign leads

  • Support execution of global (EU) campaigns, coordinating with the broader team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience spanning field marketing and hands-on digital execution, ideally in SaaS or a similarly complex sale

  • A track record of running events – conferences, dinners, webinars – that generate real pipeline, not just attendance

  • Experience running or supporting ABM programs alongside a sales team

  • Strong, hands-on HubSpot experience

  • Comfort owning a budget and reporting on ROI – you know the difference between activity and impact

  • Experience supporting or coordinating global/multi-region marketing programs

  • Experience supporting website work (CMS, landing pages)

  • A self-starter who's equally comfortable setting strategy and executing the details

  • Based in the US, Eastern time zone preferred, with willingness to travel ~30% for events

Nice to have: experience marketing into financial services or another regulated industry; experience with paid media platforms (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads); basic design skills (Canva) for quick landing page or asset turnaround.

Why Haast

  • Own a function early: you'll shape how Haast shows up in market

  • Report directly to our newly hired VP of Marketing based in the US, building this function together from the ground up

  • Work on something real and trusted by major global enterprises

  • Grow fast: learn more in 12 months than most roles offer in three years

  • Equity and upside: we share success with the people building it

  • Culture: ambitious, engineering-led, no red tape

  • Benefits: Health Insurance, 401k, Generous PTO

How to Apply

Apply with:

  1. Your resume/CV

  2. A brief note on this question: Tell us about an event or campaign you've executed that you're genuinely proud of. What was the outcome?


No closing date. We review applications on a rolling basis.

At Haast, we believe bold ideas come from diverse perspectives. We're committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in. Even if you don't tick every box, we'd love to hear from you.
data.summary: The Field Marketing Manager will lead Haast’s US field marketing end to end, including events, account-based programs, integrated campaigns, email, paid media, and sales enablement. The role also manages HubSpot, marketing budgets and ROI reporting, supports website and global campaign work, and requires approximately 30% travel.

data.title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising
data.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.

We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.

About the role

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising to help bring together advertiser insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to inform positioning, support product priorities, and execute go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to understand advertiser needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on execution, can independently drive clearly scoped workstreams, and is eager to grow their strategic ownership in a fast-moving environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to the product and marketing strategy for a defined area of OpenAI’s advertising business in partnership with senior product marketers and cross-functional partners.

  • Build an understanding of advertisers through customer research, market analysis, and competitive insights, identifying opportunities to improve positioning, adoption, and the customer experience.

  • Develop and maintain positioning and messaging for assigned products or features, translating complex capabilities into clear narratives for different advertiser audiences and use cases.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to synthesize advertiser feedback and market insights that inform roadmap discussions and product decisions.

  • Execute go-to-market plans for new products and features, independently owning defined workstreams from planning through launch and post-launch adoption.

  • Create advertiser-facing content and sales enablement materials, including product narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, case studies, and launch communications.

  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Data Science, and Analytics to track success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and recommend improvements.

  • Identify advertiser concerns and launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, escalating them appropriately and incorporating guidance into customer communications.

  • Coordinate cross-functional partners around deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines, proactively surfacing dependencies and resolving blockers within the scope of your initiatives.

  • Contribute to repeatable approaches for launches, messaging, and enablement by documenting learnings, developing templates, and sharing effective practices with the broader team.

You might be a great fit if you…

  • Have experience contributing to product marketing strategies and bringing products, features, or programs to market, ideally in advertising, marketing technology, platforms, data, or AI.

  • Have experience applying structured problem-solving approaches in product marketing, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, venture capital, or a similarly analytical environment.

  • Have familiarity with advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including areas such as measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance.

  • Can synthesize customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable recommendations, and well-executed go-to-market programs.

  • Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into accessible customer value for different audiences.

  • Are comfortable using qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to support decisions and improve results.

  • Bring structure and sound judgment to ambiguous problems, independently managing scoped initiatives while seeking input when priorities or tradeoffs are unclear.

  • Build productive working relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and other teams, contributing to alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • Are highly organized, attentive to detail, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Enjoy learning from others, sharing insights, and helping improve how the team approaches launches, storytelling, and execution.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link.

OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy

At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

data.title: Marketing Communications Manager
data.description:
Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

Job Description

The Marketing Communications Manager will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing communications programs that advance business priorities, strengthen brand visibility, and generate measurable demand. Reporting to the Marketing Director, this hands-on role will partner closely with marketing colleagues, sales, operations, technical subject matter experts, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex capabilities into clear, compelling campaigns, content, and sales tools. The successful candidate will bring strong strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and a proven ability to influence across teams without direct authority.

Summary of Key Skills

  • Integrated marketing communications strategy and campaign execution
  • Demand generation, lead nurturing, and campaign performance optimization
  • Clear, persuasive writing for technical, B2B, and audience-specific messaging
  • Problem solving, sound judgment, attention to detail, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence without direct authority
  • Project management, budget oversight, vendor coordination, and deadline accountability
  • Marketing automation, CRM, analytics, and KPI reporting

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing communications strategies, campaigns, and lead the annual medical device services marketing plan process aligned to business objectives, audience needs, and growth priorities.
  • Lead campaign planning from strategy through execution, including value proposition development, creative briefs, messaging, content mapping, activation plans, and performance measurement.
  • Create, edit, and manage high-impact content across channels, including web pages, email campaigns, paid media, sales enablement materials, thought leadership assets, presentations, social media, webinars, and event materials.
  • Partner with marketing colleagues, sales, technical SMEs, leadership, agencies, and external vendors to ensure cohesive messaging, strong execution, and alignment across target audience touchpoints.
  • Manage marketing automation, email marketing, lead nurturing, inbound lead processes, and lead scoring in partnership with sales and digital teams.
  • Plan and execute tradeshows, events, webinars, and promotional campaigns, including messaging, graphics, schedules, speaker coordination, and post-event follow-up in coordination with the marketing tradeshow specialist.
  • Own campaign performance tracking, KPI reporting, budget management, and optimization recommendations to improve engagement, lead generation, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Uphold brand standards and ensure consistent, compelling messaging across all marketing materials, digital channels in partnership with the marketing digital specialist, sales tools, and external communications.
  • Manage agency relationships, project timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure work is completed on time, on brand, and aligned to business goals.

Qualifications

The Ideal Candidate

    • Has 8 to 10 years of progressive marketing communications experience, preferably in a B2B, technical, scientific, life sciences, medical device, biopharma, or regulated industry environment.
    • Brings a proven track record of developing campaigns that drive measurable engagement, demand generation, and qualified lead growth.
    • Combines strategic thinking with strong execution, moving confidently from planning and messaging through activation, measurement, and optimization.
    • Is a resourceful problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, remove barriers, and keep complex projects moving forward.
    • Influences effectively without authority by building trust, aligning stakeholders, and communicating recommendations with clarity and confidence.
    • Writes clearly and persuasively, with the ability to translate complex technical information into audience-focused marketing messages.
    • Works well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment while maintaining strong organization, attention to detail, and accountability for deadlines.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, business, or a related field required.
  • 8 to 10 years of experience in marketing communications, campaign management, demand generation, content marketing, or a related marketing role required.
  • Demonstrated experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, CRMs, and marketing automation platforms
  • Experience in life sciences, medical device, biopharma, laboratory services, healthcare, manufacturing, technology, or another technical B2B environment preferred.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional marketing projects.

Additional Information

The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm, with overtime as needed. Location: East Coast & Midwest — Boston, MA; Lancaster, PA; Jacksonville, FL; St. Louis, MO; Remote options available

  • Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid vacation and holidays

Eurofins USA BioPharma Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

data.title: Technical Solutions Consultant (pre-sales)
data.description:
Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.

We are seeking a Technical Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales), a customer-facing technical expert responsible for helping financial institutions evaluate, design, and adopt Blockstream's enterprise software solutions.

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Solutions Engineer partners closely with Enterprise Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to support the customer journey from technical discovery and solution architecture through product demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and technical validation.

This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will spend significant time working directly with customers, often onsite, understanding their business, technical, and regulatory requirements, designing enterprise-grade solutions, and acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle. You will help financial institutions understand how Blockstream's products solve complex business challenges while ensuring proposed solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned with customer needs.

What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

Customer Engagement & Technical Sales

  • Partner with Enterprise Sales to support strategic opportunities across financial institutions.

  • Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customers' business, operational, regulatory, and technical requirements.

  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Operations, and Engineering teams.

  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs.

  • Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), solution validation activities, and technical evaluations.

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the sales process.

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures leveraging Blockstream's enterprise software products.

  • Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions and implementation approaches.

  • Define solution assumptions, integration approaches, deployment models, and technical dependencies.

  • Collaborate with customers to identify implementation risks and recommend best practices.

Commercial & Deal Support

  • Lead or contribute to responses for RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, and security assessments.

  • Support commercial discussions by providing technical expertise and solution positioning.

  • Help package Blockstream products into repeatable enterprise offerings, demonstrations, and implementation approaches.

  • Clearly communicate the value proposition and differentiators of Blockstream's products.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Security, Delivery, and Consulting teams.

  • Feed customer and market feedback back to Product Management.

  • Help improve demos, technical collateral, reference architectures, and solution playbooks.

  • Contribute to repeatable implementation methodologies and sales enablement materials.

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 5-8 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Enterprise Software Pre-Sales.

  • Experience supporting enterprise software sales within banking, financial services, fintech, or technology infrastructure environments.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software architecture, APIs, integration patterns, cloud technologies, and modern software deployment models.

  • Experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions for complex customer environments.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.

  • Experience delivering customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and executive presentations.

  • Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, technical proposals, and solution validation.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across Enterprise Sales, Product, Engineering, Consulting, and Delivery teams.

  • Self-starter with proven ability to manage multiple customer engagements while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations.

Languages:

  • Excellent English skills required.

Location:

  • New York (Remote)

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience working with financial institutions, including private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

  • Background in blockchain, Bitcoin, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

  • Knowledge of core banking platforms, financial market infrastructure, or enterprise integration technologies.

  • Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

  • Experience in enterprise software organizations serving regulated industries.

  • Track record of feeding customer and market feedback into product strategy.
data.summary: Blockstream is seeking a Technical Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) to help financial institutions evaluate, design, and adopt enterprise software solutions. The role involves technical discovery, solution architecture, demonstrations, Proofs of Concept, RFP support, and serving as a trusted technical advisor while collaborating with sales, product, engineering, security, delivery, and consulting teams.

data.title: Channel Solutions Engineer
data.description:
Lumana is on a mission to empower organizations by unlocking the value of their visual data — not just record the world, but to actually understand it and extract meaningful insights. Our AI video security platform delivers unmatched visibility and control, helping customers enhance security and safety, streamline operations, and respond instantly when it matters most.

Founded in 2021, we are backed by tier-one Silicon Valley investors with deep team expertise in AI, computer vision, and machine learning. We are one of the fastest-growing video security companies and recently raised the largest Series A within our industry. We’ve built the most intelligent video security solution on the market — one that sees what matters, acts fast, and prevents what used to be inevitable.

At Lumana, teams are small, dynamic, and trusted to lead. We think big, move fast, and execute like owners — because we are. Your impact here won’t be filtered. It will be visible, lasting, and real.

Role Description

The Channel Solutions Engineer will help build and scale our partner enablement motion across North America. As the technical counterpart to our Channel Sales organization, you will work closely with channel partners to ensure they can confidently position, demonstrate, and recommend Lumana solutions.

This role combines technical training and certification, knowledge transfer, consultation, and deep relationship building with technical partner counterparts. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading a technical workshop, conducting a product demonstration, building training content, or helping a partner architect the right solution for a customer.

Location & Travel

Remote - United States

This role supports strategic channel partners throughout North America and includes approximately 40% travel for partner meetings, training events, customer engagements, and industry conferences.

Compensation

70% base / 30% variable / $215k - $230k OTE

Final compensation will depend on location, experience, skills, and role alignment. Variable compensation is subject to the applicable incentive plan.

Responsibilities

  • Partner Enablement: Deliver technical training and onboarding programs for partner sales engineers and technical teams.

    • Develop scalable enablement materials, certifications, playbooks, and demo environments.

    • Conduct virtual and in-person workshops, lunch-and-learns, and technical training sessions.

    • Improve partner technical competency and confidence in positioning Lumana solutions.

    • Attend trade shows and events representing Lumana.

  • Technical Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships with partner engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers.

    • Serve as the primary technical advisor for assigned channel partners.

    • Success means the partner’s technical counterpart has a strong, direct relationship with our Channel Partner and actively recommends Lumana to their sales team and end customers.

  • Partner-Focused Pre-Sales Support: Support partner-led customer opportunities throughout the sales cycle.

    • Assist with discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, and product demonstrations.

    • Coach partner teams on delivering customer-facing technical presentations.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Enablement, and Solutions Engineering.

    • Provide market feedback, competitive intelligence, and product insights gathered through partner interactions.

    • Help shape Lumana's long-term partner enablement strategy and channel engineering framework.

    • Working with marketing, ensure the partner portals are the best-in-class technical resource for partners.

We don’t do cookie-cutter. If you don’t check every box but you’ve got the grit, the drive, and the track record—especially in security or AI—we encourage you to apply.

Qualifications

Must Have

  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, or similar customer-facing technical roles within physical security, video surveillance, cybersecurity, networking, SaaS, or infrastructure technology.

  • Familiarity with AI, computer vision, analytics, or video management platforms.

  • Experience supporting channel partners, distributors, resellers, or indirect sales motions.

  • Strong networking and IP infrastructure fundamentals.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, sales acumen, and technical storytelling skills.

data.title: Senior Director, Ad Tech Solutions
data.description:
Company Description

At Blend360, we help organizations transform complex data into actionable insights through modern cloud platforms, advanced analytics, and AI-driven solutions. We partner with leading enterprises across healthcare, telecommunications, financial services, and retail to build scalable, high-impact data ecosystems that drive smarter business decisions. 

Job Description

Blend360 is leading a zero-to-one data monetization platform build and launch for a major US-based telecommunications company. Our team is responsible for the build, delivery, and commercialization of every aspect of the platform, from AI-driven intelligence to product development and go-to-market motions. 

Blend360 is looking for a Senior Director, Ad Tech Solutions to serve as the technical bridge between our enterprise partners, sales teams, and the data monetization product and technical organization. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role for someone who understands the ad tech and martech ecosystem, can navigate complex enterprise conversations, and knows how to translate technical capabilities into solutions that solve real business problems. 

You’ll be the go-to technical partner throughout the sales process—working alongside sales to understand opportunities, solution data monetization products and capabilities against client needs, and bring the right technical experts into the conversation at the right time. You’ll participate directly in enterprise partner calls, help shape solution strategy, and ensure clients have a clear understanding of what the data monetization  platform can do, how it works, and how it can create value for their business. 

Just as importantly, you’ll own the documentation and enablement that supports the commercial organization. From FAQs and training materials to match-test results and technical solution summaries, you’ll turn complex product and technical information into clear, useful resources that sales teams and partners can actually use. You’ll work across Product, Testing, Integrations, Identity, and other technical teams to bring the right expertise together and keep everyone aligned. 

This is a role for a strategic, technically credible relationship builder who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a solution with an internal technical team, answering questions on an enterprise partner call, and helping a sales leader position a solution for a major opportunity. 

What You’ll Do 

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison between enterprise client teams, Sales, and Latis product and technical experts. 

  • Partner with Sales to understand client challenges and solution data monetization products, capabilities, and data against active sales opportunities. 

  • Lead technical discovery and solutioning conversations with prospective and existing enterprise partners. 

  • Participate in and support senior-level client and partner calls, providing technical expertise, answering questions, and helping move opportunities forward. 

  • Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, partner-ready solutions, stories, and recommendations. 

  • Coordinate across Product, Testing, Integrations, Identity, Data, and other subject-matter experts to bring the right people and capabilities into each opportunity. 

  • Own the creation and ongoing development of sales and partner enablement materials, including FAQs, training content, technical documentation, match-test results, and solution summaries. 

  • Help sales teams understand how to position data monetization capabilities, anticipate technical questions, and navigate enterprise client conversations. 

  • Partner with internal teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, clearly documented, and aligned with what data monetization can deliver. 

  • Identify recurring client questions, objections, and technical needs and translate them into opportunities to improve product documentation, enablement, and the overall sales motion. 

  • Bring structure and clarity to complex opportunities where requirements, stakeholders, and technical considerations may be evolving. 

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to both internal stakeholders and enterprise partners throughout the sales and solutioning lifecycle. 

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in ad tech, martech, data platforms, marketing technology, or a closely related field. 

  • Significant experience in customer-facing technical roles, such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or a similar function. 

  • Deep familiarity with the ad tech and/or martech ecosystem, including the data, identity, audience, measurement, and technology layers that support modern advertising. 

  • The ability to take a complex technical capability and translate it into a practical solution tied to a client's business needs. 

  • Strong enterprise presence and experience working directly with senior client and partner stakeholders. 

  • Demonstrated ability to support complex sales opportunities, from discovery and solution design through technical validation and close. 

Additional Information

The starting pay range for this role is $230,000- $260,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

data.title: Marketing Enablement Manager
data.description:
Company Description

Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients.

Job Description

Our client is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and execution-focused Marketing Enablement & Project Manager to support its North American Marketing Services and Practice Development team. This role is responsible for helping bring marketing capabilities and solutions to market, developing sales enablement materials, and coordinating cross-functional projects from concept through completion.

The ideal candidate is a strong project manager and stakeholder partner who thrives in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent initiatives. You'll work closely with internal teams to connect the dots, drive projects forward, navigate approval processes, and ensure deliverables are completed on time.

This is a highly collaborative, self-directed role that supports the broader marketing and business development organization. Success requires strong organizational skills, executive presence, excellent communication, and the ability to move seamlessly between strategic context and hands-on execution.

The Details:

  • Location: Fully remote within the U.S.
  • Duration: Approximately a 6-month consulting role through Blend with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
  • Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!

What you’ll do:

Marketing Enablement & Sales Support

  • Create and maintain sales enablement materials, presentations, one-pagers, training resources, and other materials that help frontline sales teams communicate marketing services, products, and capabilities.
  • Develop educational content that translates new offerings and complex marketing solutions into clear, compelling, and actionable messaging.
  • Support the creation of business development presentations, executive-level decks, and materials used to communicate value propositions and business outcomes.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to prepare sales teams for new product launches, capabilities, and service offerings.
  • Help develop and organize training materials that enable internal teams to effectively position and sell new solutions.

Project & Stakeholder Management

  • Own projects from initiation through completion, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder expectations remain aligned.
  • Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while navigating changing priorities and requests from leadership.
  • Develop project plans, coordinate milestones, track progress, and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, resolve challenges, and drive projects across the finish line.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up among stakeholders, ensuring accountability and momentum throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Take initiative to identify what needs to be done, determine the appropriate next steps, and move work forward with minimal oversight.

Marketing Capabilities & Go-to-Market Support

  • Support the development and commercialization of new marketing capabilities, products, and service offerings.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities required to bring new capabilities to market, including internal review, approval, and readiness processes.
  • Partner with privacy, legal, risk, and other relevant stakeholders to help navigate governance and approval requirements.
  • Connect the dots across teams, processes, and deliverables to support the successful launch of new marketing solutions.
  • Assist with the development of repeatable processes, materials, and frameworks that support broader team enablement and solution delivery.
  • Support marketing initiatives related to customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifecycle marketing.

Leadership Communication & Business Support

  • Prepare updates, presentations, and progress reports for leadership and other internal stakeholders.
  • Present project updates and materials to leadership with confidence, clarity, and professionalism.
  • Respond effectively to ad hoc requests and shifting business needs while maintaining organization and attention to detail.
  • Build strong working relationships across marketing, sales, product, risk, legal, creative, analytics, and other partner teams.
  • Leverage AI-enabled productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar solutions, to improve efficiency, support content development, and streamline workflows.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing, marketing enablement, product marketing, project management, consulting, financial services marketing, agency account management, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects from start to finish, including planning, coordination, execution, and delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with individuals across different teams and levels of an organization.
  • Experience developing high-quality PowerPoint presentations, sales enablement materials, training resources, and executive-level communications.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and proactively identify solutions to move projects forward.
  • Comfortable presenting to leadership and communicating project updates, recommendations, and key information with executive presence.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible materials.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services, banking, payments, fintech, or marketing technology.
  • Background in lifecycle marketing, customer acquisition, direct marketing, audience targeting, or campaign strategy.
  • Experience supporting sales enablement, product launches, go-to-market initiatives, or marketing capability development.
  • Familiarity with privacy, legal, compliance, risk, or governance approval processes.
  • Experience developing marketing strategies, business development presentations, or materials designed to support revenue growth.
  • Prior experience working with large financial services organizations or payments companies.
  • Experience using AI-powered productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot or similar technologies, to support marketing and project execution.

Additional Information

The pay range for this role is $60-65 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

A diverse workforce is a strong workforce
To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success.  We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.

BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

About the Role:

This role owns the systems, policies, and processes governing time tracking, leave management, and absence administration—ensuring accuracy, compliance, and a seamless employee experience across all regions. The ideal candidate combines strong program management skills with deep expertise in time and attendance systems and global leave/absence regulations.

What You'll Do:

  • Define program goals and success metrics  for accuracy, compliance, and supportive employee experiences

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work with regional stakeholders to balance global standards with local requirements

  • Work closely with Product Manager and IT to optimize time and absence modules within Workday

Compliance & Governance

Change Management & Enablement

  • Lead change management for new system rollouts and  policy updates

  • Provide guidance and support to HR teams, managers, and employees

  • Gather feedback to inform continuous improvement

What You'll Need:
